verdict.rationale: Crossplane's control-plane model continuously reconciles declared desired state against actual cloud resources and self-corrects drift automatically, as documented directly ('If your software ever drifts from your desired state, the control plane automatically corrects the drift'). This is reinforced by its reconciliation-based architecture (managed resources, compositions) rather than one-off plan/apply. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification/benchmarks of drift-detection behavior in production, and no detail on drift visibility/reporting tooling (e.g., diffing UI) beyond auto-correction.
